subject: English
instructions: Read the sentences and questions carefully. Choose or fill in the correct naming word (noun) or action word (verb).

questions.question: Which of these words is a Noun (naming word for an animal)?
questions.explanation: Elephant is the name of an animal, so it is a Noun.

questions.question: Identify the Action Word in the sentence: 'The boy kicks the football.'
Complete the sentence with the correct action word: 'Fish _____ in the clear river water.'
Which group contains ONLY nouns?
questions.explanation: Doctor (person), School (place), Pencil (thing) are all nouns.

questions.question: Is the underlined word in 'Ravi eats an apple' a Noun or an Action Word? Word: 'eats'
